verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published pricing for Zoom Scribe: no per-minute or per-hour rate and no itemized add-on prices for features like diarization, text polishing, or the Pro model. An agent therefore has nothing to compute a job's cost from before submitting it. The axis applies to a paid transcription API, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can compute the cost of a transcription job before submitting it, because pricing is published per audio minute or hour with add-on prices itemized
